fields.System.Title: INT-501 — Products with no barcode
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want a list of products that cannot be scanned, so that
they are fixed before a picker mistypes a code and ships the wrong item.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the report, then it lists every active product with no barcode record.
  • - Given the report, then products currently holding stock are listed first — they are
  • the ones that will be scanned.
  • - Given a product deliberately without a barcode, then it can be marked as an accepted
  • exception and suppressed.
  • - Given the report, then it runs weekly and its output reaches a person.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, masterdata |
| Tables | product, product_barcode, stock_balance |
| Risks | Manual entry causing wrong-item picks ([doc 03 §7.3](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
